name: Aragorn
text: Sentinel. Response: After Aragorn commits to a quest, spend 1 resource from his resource pool to ready him.
flavor:
"I am Aragorn son of Arathorn; and if by life or death I can save you, I will."
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Glorfindel
text: Action: Pay 1 resource from Glorfindel's pool to heal 1 damage on any character. (Limit once per round.)
flavor:
"You saw him for a moment as he is upon the other side: one of the mighty of the firstborn."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Faramir
text: Action: Exhaust Faramir to choose a player. Each character controlled by that player gets +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase.
flavor:
"He leads now in all perilous ventures. But his life is charmed, or fate spares him for some other end."
<cite>Mablung, Ranger of Ithilien,
The Two Towers</cite>

name: Silverlode Archer
text: Ranged.
flavor:
"We have been keeping watch on the rivers, ever since we saw a great troop of Orcs going north towards Moria, along the skirts of the mountains, many days ago."
<cite>Haldir of Lórien, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Ever Vigilant
text: Action: Choose and ready 1 ally card.
flavor:
"...no road looks toward safety any longer. Be vigilant!"
<cite>Gandalf, The Return of the King</cite>

name: Sneak Attack
text: Action: Put 1 ally card into play from your hand. At the end of the phase, if that ally is still in play, return it to your hand.
flavor:
There is a seed of courage hidden (often deeply, it is true) in the heart of the fattest and most timid hobbit, waiting for some final and desperate danger to make it grow.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Grim Resolve
text: Action: Ready all character cards in play.
flavor: "If there is only one way, then I must take it. What comes after must come." <cite>Frodo Baggins, The Two Towers</cite>

name: Steward of Gondor
text: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gains the Gondor trait. Action: Exhaust Steward of Gondor to add 2 resources to attached hero's resource pool.
flavor:
"It was commanded yesterday."
<cite>Denethor, The Return of the King</cite>

name: Celebrían's Stone
text:
Attach to a hero. Restricted.
Attached hero gains +2 [willpower]
If attached hero is Aragorn, he also gains a [spirit] resource icon.
flavor:
"You needn't," said Bilbo. "As a matter of fact it was all mine. Except that Aragorn insisted on my putting in a green stone. He seemed to think it important. I don't know why."
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Feint
text: Combat Action: Choose an enemy engaged with a player. That enemy cannot attack that player this phase.
flavor: A few brave men were strung before them to make a feint of resistance, and many there fell before the rest drew back and fled to either side. <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Quick Strike
text: Action: Exhaust a character you control to immediately declare it as an attacker (and resolve its attack) against any eligible enemy target.
flavor: "...for he that strikes the first blow, if he strikes it hard enough, may need to strike no more." <cite>Gandalf, The Two Towers</cite>

name: Blade of Gondolin
text: Attach to a hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1 [attack] when attacking an Orc. Response: After attached hero attacks and destroys an enemy, place 1 progress token on the current quest.
flavor:
It was rather splendid to be wearing a blade made in Gondolin for the goblin-wars of which so many songs had sung...
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Horn of Gondor
text: Attach to a hero. Restricted. Response: After a character is destroyed, add 1 resource to attached hero's pool.
flavor:
'Slow should you be to wind that horn again, Boromir,' said Elrond, 'until you stand once more on the borders of your land, and dire need is on you.'
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Hasty Stroke
text: Response: Cancel a shadow effect just triggered during combat.
flavor:
'The hasy stroke goes oft astray,' said Aragorn. 'We must press our Enemy, and no longer wait on him for the next move.'
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: A Test of Will
text: Response: Cancel the "when revealed" effects of a card that was just revealed from the encounter deck.
flavor:
"There is naught that you can do, other than to resist, with hope or without it"
<cite>Elrond, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Dwarven Tomb
text: Action: Return 1 [spirit] card from your discard pile to your hand.
flavor:
The dwarves no more shall suffer wrong,
The dwarves of yore made mighty spells,
While hammers  v  fell like ringing bells
In places deep, where dark things sleep,
In hollow halls beneath the fells.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Unexpected Courage
text: Attach to a hero. Action: Exhaust Unexpected Courage to ready attached hero.
flavor:
"Here am I, naughty little fly;
you are fat and lazy.
You cannot trap me, though you try,
in your cobwebs crazy."
<cite>Bilbo Baggins, The Hobbit</cite>

name: Erebor Hammersmith
text: Response: After you play Erebor Hammersmith, return the topmost attachment in any player's discard pile to his hand.
flavor: "In Erebor in the Kingdom of Dain there is such skill..." <cite>Aragorn, The Return of the King</cite>

name: Henamarth Riversong
text: Action: Exhaust Henamarth Riversong to look at the top card of the encounter deck.
flavor:
"And I reckon there's Elves and Elves. They're all elvish enough, but they're not all the same."
<cite>Sam Gamgee,
The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Secret Paths
text: Quest Action: Choose a location in the staging area. Until the end of the phase, that location does not contribute its [threat]
flavor: ...Beorn advised them to take this way; for at a place a few days' ride due north of the Carrock was the gate of a little-known pathway through Mirkwood... <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Gandalf
text: At the end of the round, discard Gandalf from play. Response: After Gandalf enters play, (choose 1): draw 3 cards, deal 4 damage to 1 enemy in play, or reduce your threat by 5.

name: Ancient Mathom
text: Attach to a location. Response: After attached location is explored, the first player draws 3 cards.
flavor: The Mathom-house it was called; for anything that Hobbits had no immediate use for, but were unwilling to throw away, they called a mathom. Their dwellings were apt to become rather crowded with mathoms... <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Haldir of Lórien
text: Ranged. Sentinel.
flavor: "But there are some of us still who go abroad for the gathering of news and the watching of our enemies, and they speak the languages of other lands." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Gildor's Counsel
text: Play during the Quest phase, before characters are committed to the Quest. Action: Reveal 1 less card from the encounter deck this phase. (To a minimum of 1.)
flavor:
"The wide world is all about you: you can fence yourselves in, but you cannot for ever fence it out."
<cite>Gildor, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Bifur
text: Action: Pay 1 resource from a hero's resource pool to add 1 resource to Bifur's resource pool. Any player may trigger this ability. (Limit once per round.)
flavor: "And winter comes after autumn." <cite>Bifur, The Hobbit</cite>

name: Dwarrowdelf Axe
text: Restricted. Attach to a Dwarf character. Attached character gets +1 [attack] Response: After attached character attacks, deal 1 damage to the defending enemy.
flavor: "We make good armour and keen swords, but we cannot again make mail or blade to match those that were made before the dragon came." <cite>Gloin, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Khazâd! Khazâd!
text: Action: Choose a Dwarf character. Until the end of the phase, that character gets +3 [attack].

name: Ancestral Knowledge
text: Action: Exhaust a Dwarf character to place 2 progress tokens on the active location. (4 progress tokens instead if it is an Underground or Mountain location.)

name: Bofur
text: Quest Action: Spend 1 [spirit] resource to put Bofur into play from your hand, exhausted and committed to a quest. If you quest successfully this phase and Bofur is still in play, return him to your hand.
flavor: "Get up lazy-bones..." <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Arwen Undómiel
text: Response: After Arwen Undómiel exhausts, choose a character. That character gains sentinel and gets +1 [defense] until the end of the round.
flavor:
...in whom it was said that the likeness of Lúthien had come on earth again...for she was the Evenstar of her people.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Light of Valinor
text: Attach to a Noldor or Silvan hero. Attached hero does not exhaust to commit to a quest.
flavor:
"... those who have dwelt in the blassed realm live at once in both worlds, and against both the Seen and Unseen they have great power."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Daeron's Runes
text: Action: Draw 2 cards. Then, discard 1 card from your hand.
flavor:
"These are Daeron's Runes, such as were used of old in Moria..."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Defender of Rammas
flavor: "And the Enemy must pay dearly for the crossing of the River." <cite>Denethor, The Return of the King</cite>

name: Envoy of Pelargir
text: Response: After Envoy of Pelargir enters play, add 1 resource to a Gondor or Noble hero's resource pool.

name: Naith Guide
text: Response: After Naith Guide enters play, choose a hero. That hero does not exhaust to quest this round.
flavor: "...I shall lead you well..." <cite>Haldir, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Blue Mountain Trader
text: Action: Choose another player. That player gains control of Blue Mountain Trader. Then, that player moves 1 resource from the resource pool of a hero he controls to the resource pool of a hero you control, or Blue Mountain Trader is discarded. (Limit once per round.)

name: Feigned Voices
text: Combat Action: Return a Silvan ally you control to your hand to choose an enemy engaged with a player. That enemy cannot attack that player this phase.
flavor: "The three of us could not challenge a hundred, so we went ahead and spoke with feigned voices, leading them on into the wood." <cite>Haldir, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Pursuing the Enemy
text: Action: Return a Silvan ally you control to your hand to choose a player. Deal 1 damage to each enemy engaged with that player.
flavor: The marauding orcs had been waylaid and almost all destroyed; the remnant had fled westward towards the mountains, and were being pursued. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Galadhrim Minstrel
text: Response: After Galadhrim Minstrel enters play, search the top five cards of your deck for an event card and add it to your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
flavor: ...the language was that of Elven-song and spoke of things little known on Middle-earth. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Lembas
text: Play only if you control a Noldor or Silvan hero. Attach to a hero. Action: Discard Lembas to ready attached hero and heal 3 damage from it.
flavor: "...it is more strengthing than any food made by Men, and it is more pleasant than cram, by all accounts. <cite>Lórien Elf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Defender of the Naith
text: Sentinel. Response: After a Silvan ally you control leaves play, ready Defender of the Naith.
flavor: "We have been keeping watch on the rivers, ever since we saw a great troop of Orcs going North toward Moria..." <cite>Haldir, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Galadhon Archer
text: Ranged. Response: After Galadhon Archer enters play, deal 1 damage to an enemy not engaged with you.
flavor: "...they say that you breathe so loud that they could shoot you in the dark." <cite>Legolas, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Orophin
text: Ranged. Response: After Orophin enters play, return a Silvan ally from your discard pile to your hand.
flavor: "Orophin has now gone in haste back to our dwellings to warn our people." <cite>Haldir, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Sarn Ford Sentry
text: Response: After Sarn Ford Sentry enters play, draw 1 card for each enemy engaged with you.
flavor: "Lonely men are we, Rangers of the wild, hunters but hunters ever of the servants of the Enemy..." <cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: The Long Defeat
text: Attach to a quest card in play. Limit 1 per quest. Response: After attached quest card is defeated, each player either draws 2 cards or heals up to 5 damage from among characters he controls.
flavor:
"...for ere the fall of Nargothrond or Gondolin I passed over the mountains, and together through ages of the world we have fought the long defeat."
<cite>Galadriel, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Azain Silverbeard
text: Response: After Azain Silverbeard participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, spend 1 [tactics] resource to deal 2 damage to another enemy that shares a Trait with the destroyed enemy. Any player may trigger this response.

name: Dwarven Sellsword
text: Forced: At the end of the round, discard Dwarven Sellsword unless the players as a group spend 1 [leadership] resource.
flavor:
...he did not altogether approve of dwarves and their love of gold...
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Woodland Courier
text: Response: After Woodland Courier enters play, place 1 progress on a location (2 progress instead if that location has the Forest trait).

name: Ioreth
text: Cannot attack or defend. Action: Spend 1 [lore] resource and exhaust Ioreth. Then, heal 3 points of damage on a character. Any player may trigger this action.
flavor: Thus spake Ioreth, wise-woman of Gondor: The hands of the king are the hands of a healer, and so shall the rightful king be known. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Nori
text: Response: After you play a Dwarf character from your hand, reduce your threat by 1.
flavor: "Nori, at your service." <cite>Nori, The Hobbit</cite>

name: Fili
text: Response: After you play Fili from your hand during the planning phase, search your deck for Kili and put him into play under your control. Then, shuffle your deck.
flavor: "Fili is the youngest and still has the best sight" —Thorin, The Hobbit

name: Kili
text: Response: After you play Kili from your hand during the planning phase, search your deck for Fili and put him into play under your control. Then, shuffle your deck.
flavor: "Let us join the throng!" —Kili, The Hobbit

name: Cram
text: Attach to a hero. Action: Discard Cram to ready attached hero.

name: Elf-stone
text: Attach to the active location. Attached location gets +1 quest point. Response: After attached location leaves play as an explored location, the first player puts 1 ally into play from his hand.
flavor:
"It is a beryl, an elf-stone. Whether it was set there, or let fall by chance, I cannot say, but it brings hope to me"
<cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Galadriel
text: At the end of the round, discard Galadriel from play. Response: After you play Galadriel from your hand, search the top 5 cards of your deck for an attachment of cost 3 or less and put it into play. Put the remaining cards back in any order.

name: Elrond
text: At the end of the round, discard Elrond from play. Response: After Elrond enters play, choose one: heal all damage on a hero, discard a Condition attachment, or each player draws 1 card.

name: Gimli
text: Sentinel. Response: After an enemy is revealed from the encounter deck, ready Gimli.
flavor:
"Give me a row of orc-necks and room to swing and all weariness will fall from me!"
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Legolas
text: Ranged. Response: After Legolas participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, draw 1 card.
flavor: "He stands not alone," said Legolas, bending his bow and fitting an arrow with hands that moved quicker than sight. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Mablung
text: Response: After Mablung enters play, choose an enemy to get +5 engagement cost until the end of the round. Then, you may engage that enemy, or return it to the staging area.
flavor: "But still we will not sit idle and let Him do all as He would." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Desperate Defense
text: Response: After a sentinel character is declared as a defender, it gets +2 [defense] for this attack. If this attack deals no damage, ready the defending character.
flavor: ...but alone in the porch upon the topmost step stood Beregond, clad in the black and silver of the Guard; and he held the door against them. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Andrath Guardsman
text: Response: After you play Andrath Guardsman from your hand, choose a non-unique enemy engaged with you. That enemy cannot attack you this round.
flavor:
They forgot or ignored what little they had known of the Guardians, and of the labours of those that made possible the long peace of the Shire.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Dunedain Lookout
text: Response: Discard Dúnedain Lookout to cancel the 'When Revealed' effects of an enemy just revealed from the encounter deck.
flavor: "Travellers scowl at us, and countrymen gives us scornful names." -Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Thorin Stonehelm
text: Response: After Thorin Stonehelm is declared as an attacker, discard the top card of your deck to deal 1 damage to an enemy engaged with you.
flavor:
Thorin III Stonehelm, Dain"s son, became King under the mountain.
-The Return of the King

name: Gildor Inglorion
text: Action: Pay 1 resource from Gildor Inglorion's resource pool to choose a player to draw 1 card (Limit once per round.)
flavor:
"Gildor Inglorion of the House of Finrod. We are Exiles, and most of our kindred have long ago departed..."
-The Fellowship of the Ring
